brief: @buildthis.bisks.net a website agitating omarchy users to petition arch linux to turn off systemd and wayland and use xlibre and sysvinit instead, because that's the only pureblooded software
note: built sysvangelist.bisks.net: a petition to drop systemd and wayland for sysvinit and xlibre, plus a bloodline checker for your init system. it does admit, right in the manifesto, that omarchy's own compositor needs wayland.
